hook: Your telescope mirror is 18 gold hexagons.
title: Webb's Mirror Is 18 Gold Hexagons
description:
The James Webb Space Telescope's mirror is built from 18 hexagonal beryllium segments with a thin gold coating. Gold reflects infrared light very well, which is what Webb is built to see.

Series: Space Facts That Sound Fake.
comment_prompt: Gold telescope: cool or too fancy? Cool or fancy
